title: Henderson, NV — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Henderson, NV: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Henderson is a city in NV with a population of 331,415. Vegas suburb with master-planned communities, no state income tax, and desert luxury. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 9a growing zone supports Warm to hot — citrus, tropical fruits, year-round growing. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 292 sunny days a year.
